compliance_decision:
1. Transactions involving sanctioned entities should not be conducted and must immediately cease, as per the DPMS's obligations under section 29 of the FIC Act when dealing with clients on a sanctions list.
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: Section 29 to the Financial Institution Compliance (FIC) Act regarding suspicious transactions and handling entities listed on sanctions lists, as well as regulations concerning High-Value Goods Dealings (HVGD).
3. Explanation: The DPMS is prohibited from continuing with a transaction if the client involved has been placed on any of the relevant sanctions lists according to section 29 of the FIC Act, which also applies when dealing in high-value goods that may be intended for evasion as per regulations concerning HVGD.
